IMPORTANT NOTICE TO PERSONS ON MEDICARE
THIS INSURANCE DUPLICATES SOME MEDICARE BENEFITS
This is not Medicare Supplement Insurance
This insurance pays a fixed dollar amount, regardless of your expenses, for each day you meet the policy
conditions. It does not pay your Medicare deductibles or coinsurance and is not a substitute for Medicare
This insurance duplicates Medicare benefits when:
•   any expenses or services covered by the policy are also covered by Medicare
Medicare generally pays for most or all of these expenses.
Medicare pays extensive benefits for medically necessary services regardless of the reason you need
•   outpatient prescription drugs if you are enrolled in Medicare Part D
√   For more information about Medicare and Medicare Supplement Insurance, review the Guide to Health
Insurance for People with Medicare, available from the insurance company.
